newsitem.title: CHINA: Seapower Res mulls sale of warehouses.
newsitem.headline: Seapower Res mulls sale of warehouses.

text.p: Seapower Resources International Ltd said on Tuesday it had been approached regarding possible sale of its warehouses in Kwai Chung in Hong Kong's New Territories.

"The company has been approached by various real estate agents indicating that there are independent third parties who might be interested in acquiring one or more of the warehouses," the company said in the statement.
"No details have been given by these real estate agents," it said.
The cold-storage and property financing concern said it would consider seriously if it received creditable proposal or offer for the purchase of the warehouses.
Shares of Seapower Resources rose HK$0.46 or 34.85 percent to end at HK$1.78 on Tuesday. Volume was 180.4 million shares worth HK$278.38 million.
